notes: grade cap (wave c3, LB-Q-grafana-dashboard): the oracle is tier C, a walk of its own over Grafana's documented dashboard model and provisioning files (calibration/oracles/grafana; no Grafana tool reads a dashboard offline, and Grafana's AGPL-3.0 source is a behaviour reference only) with the Prometheus parser's ExtractSelectors over each Prometheus-typed, macro-substituted query, so every level it grades is good at most (design §1.3) though every metric reads 1

observability pairs (obs_* counts, wave c3) are scored into xref_precision and xref_recall with the oracle's cross_references: an Alertmanager route's or inhibit rule's alertname to the Prometheus alerting rule, an alerting rule to the receivers Alertmanager's dispatch routes its static labels to (decided rules only; fathom's routes_to edges), a Grafana panel's or alert rule's metric to the recording rule, a uid link, a datasource uid, a provider's directory, resolved by fusion.ResolveObsXrefs (the resolver ingest stores those doc-xref edges from) over the files ingest reads; obs_unresolved_<reason> counts the measured files' references that joined nothing (undeclared: a metric no recording rule records, a templated uid, a datasource or contact point the repository does not provision)
